import math
import unittest

from solution import stream_totals


class StreamTotalsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_totals_and_first_appearance_order(self):
        records = [
            ("beta", 2),
            ("alpha", 1.5),
            ("beta", -0.5),
            ("gamma", 0),
            ("alpha", 2),
        ]
        snapshot = records[:]
        self.assertEqual(
            stream_totals(records),
            [("beta", 1.5), ("alpha", 3.5), ("gamma", 0)],
        )
        self.assertEqual(records, snapshot)

    def test_empty_and_one_shot_inputs(self):
        self.assertEqual(stream_totals([]), [])
        records = ((category, amount) for category, amount in (("x", 1), ("x", 2)))
        self.assertEqual(stream_totals(records), [("x", 3)])

    def test_does_not_preconsume_after_malformed_record(self):
        requested = []

        def records():
            requested.append(0)
            yield ("ok", 1)
            requested.append(1)
            yield ("bad", True)
            requested.append(2)
            raise AssertionError("requested a later record")

        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            stream_totals(records())
        self.assertEqual(requested, [0, 1])

    def test_invalid_outer_values(self):
        for value in ("records", b"records", 3, None):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    stream_totals(value)

    def test_record_shape_validation(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            stream_totals([["x", 1]])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            stream_totals([("x",)])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            stream_totals([("x", 1, 2)])

    def test_category_validation(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            stream_totals([(4, 1)])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            stream_totals([("", 1)])

    def test_amount_validation(self):
        for value in (True, "1", None, 1 + 1j):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    stream_totals([("x", value)])
        for value in (math.inf, -math.inf, math.nan):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    stream_totals([("x", value)])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
